data.name: Complete Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Complete Physical Exam
data.description: Complete physical examination excluding pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations unless clinically indicated. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and signs/symptoms of active TB including peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment
data.description: Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and signs/symptoms of active TB including peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, minimal presenting problems

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Measurement of pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature.

data.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram

code.decode: Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads

data.label: ECG, 12-lead (single, local)
data.description: Single 12-lead ECG performed locally at screening, Week 2, and Week 12 of Study Period 1, and at early discontinuation if prior to Week 12.

data.name: Chest X-Ray

code.decode: Radiologic examination, chest; 2 views

data.label: X-ray of Chest
data.description: Chest x-ray performed locally in posterior-anterior view and lateral view if needed, interpreted and reported by a radiologist or pulmonologist. Used for TB evaluation. A chest CT scan can be used instead.

data.name: Chest CT Scan

code.decode: Computed tomography, thorax; without contrast material

data.label: Chest CT
data.description: Chest CT scan used as an alternative to chest x-ray for TB evaluation if performed within the same time window.

data.name: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry Scan

code.decode: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study, 1 or more sites

data.label: DXA Scan
data.description: DXA scan with radiation exposure (effective dose) of approximately 5 μSv or 0.005 mSv. Performed during Study Period 1 and at early discontinuation if during Study Period 1.

data.name: Endoscopy with Biopsy

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Endoscopy with Biopsy
data.description: Endoscopy performed on all participants during screening within 21 days before randomization and at Week 12 of Study Period 1. Biopsy obtained for colonic tissue biomarker collection. A second endoscopy is allowed if inadequate preparation or equipment issues.

data.name: Venipuncture - Hematology

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw for Hematology
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for hematology laboratory analysis.

data.name: Venipuncture - Clinical Chemistry

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw for Clinical Chemistry
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for clinical chemistry laboratory analysis.

data.name: Venipuncture - Coagulation

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw for Coagulation
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for coagulation testing at screening.

data.name: Venipuncture - Fasting Lipids

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Fasting Blood Draw for Lipids
data.description: Collection of fasting venous blood samples for lipid panel testing.

data.name: Serum Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Gonadotropin, chorionic (hCG); quantitative

data.label: Serum Pregnancy Test
data.description: Serum pregnancy test for individuals of childbearing potential (IOCBP) at screening.

data.name: Urine Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Urine pregnancy test, by visual color comparison methods

data.label: Urine Pregnancy Test (Local)
data.description: Urine pregnancy test for IOCBP; negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, done on site only. In Study Period 2, can be done on-site or at home.

data.name: Follicle-Stimulating Hormone Test

code.decode: Follicle stimulating hormone (FSH)

data.label: FSH Test
data.description: Optional blood test to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals assigned female at birth (AFAB).

data.name: Urinalysis

code.decode: Urinalysis, by dip stick or tablet reagent for bilirubin, glucose, hemoglobin, ketones, leukocytes, nitrite, pH, protein, specific gravity, and urobilinogen

data.label: Urinalysis
data.description: Urine sample collection and analysis performed at screening.

data.name: HIV Testing

code.decode: Antibody; HIV-1 and HIV-2, single result

data.label: HIV Test
data.description: HIV testing performed at screening.

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus Screening

code.decode: Infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay technique, hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)

data.label: HBV Screening
data.description: Hepatitis B virus screening including HBsAg and anti-HBc. If HBsAg is negative and anti-HBc is positive, further testing for HBV DNA is required.

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus DNA Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Hepatitis B virus, quantitative

data.label: HBV DNA Test
data.description: HBV DNA testing for participants who are anti-HBc positive at screening, performed at multiple visits for monitoring.

data.name: Hepatitis C Virus Screening

code.decode: Hepatitis C antibody

data.label: HCV Screening
data.description: Hepatitis C virus screening; if HCV Ab test is positive, perform HCV RNA test.

data.name: Tuberculosis Testing

code.decode: Skin test; tuberculosis, intradermal

data.label: TB Test (TST/PPD)
data.description: Tuberculosis testing at screening. Participants who had a TST will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have results read. PPD test must be read by a trained medical professional.

data.name: Fecal Calprotectin Testing

code.decode: Calprotectin, fecal

data.label: Fecal Calprotectin
data.description: Stool sample collection and testing for fecal calprotectin as a biomarker of intestinal inflammation.

data.name: Stool Culture

code.decode: Culture, bacterial; stool, aerobic, with isolation and presumptive identification of isolates

data.label: Stool Culture
data.description: Stool culture testing; additional testing allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion.

data.name: Clostridioides difficile Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid; Clostridium difficile, toxin gene(s)

data.label: C. difficile Testing
data.description: Stool testing for Clostridioides difficile; additional testing allowed throughout the study at the investigator's discretion.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Blood Sample
data.description: Collection of blood samples for exploratory biomarker analysis.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Stool Supernatant Collection

code.decode: Sputum obtaining specimen, aerosol induced technique

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Stool Supernatant
data.description: Collection of stool supernatant from the same stool sample used for fecal calprotectin testing for exploratory biomarker analysis.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Colonic Tissue Collection

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Colonic Tissue
data.description: Collection of colonic tissue obtained from endoscopic biopsy for exploratory biomarker analysis.

data.name: Genetics Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood sample collection for genetic analysis, if country regulations allow.

data.name: Pharmacokinetics Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: PK Blood Sample
data.description: Collection of blood samples for pharmacokinetic analysis of study interventions.

data.name: Immunogenicity Blood Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Immunogenicity Sample
data.description: Collection of blood samples for immunogenicity assessments.

data.name: Intravenous Infusion of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Chemotherapy administration, intravenous infusion technique; up to 1 hour, single or initial substance/drug

data.label: Mirikizumab IV Infusion
data.description: Intravenous administration of mirikizumab on-site during Study Period 1 at Weeks 0, 4, and 8.

data.name: Subcutaneous Injection of Mirikizumab

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: Mirikizumab SC Injection
data.description: Subcutaneous administration of mirikizumab during Study Period 2. Initial administration on-site; subsequent doses can be self-administered at home by participant or caregiver after training.

data.name: Oral Administration of LY4395089

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit

data.label: LY4395089 Oral Dosing
data.description: Daily oral administration of LY4395089 6 mg QD by participant at home.

data.name: Fistula Evaluation

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Fistula Evaluation
data.description: Evaluation for existing perianal fistulas (if present at baseline) and for any newly developed fistulas.

data.name: Crohn's Disease Activity Index Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: CDAI Assessment
data.description: Assessment of Crohn's Disease Activity Index. Patient-reported items recorded daily via eDiary; clinician-reported items recorded at specified site visits.

data.name: Depression and Suicidal Ideation Risk Monitoring

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment

data.label: C-SSRS / QIDS-SR16 Assessment
data.description: Monitoring of depression and suicidal ideation and behavior risk using Columbia Suicide-Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) and Quick Inventory for Depressive Symptomatology - Self Report 16 items (QIDS-SR16).

data.name: Hypersensitivity Reaction Monitoring

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Hypersensitivity Reaction Monitoring
data.description: Monitoring and evaluation of hypersensitivity reactions including systemic hypersensitivity reactions with laboratory samples collected at time of reaction.

data.name: Injection/Infusion Site Reaction Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: ISR Assessment
data.description: Assessment and monitoring of injection and infusion site reactions (ISRs).

data.name: Hepatic Safety Monitoring

code.decode: Hepatic function panel

data.label: Hepatic Safety Monitoring
data.description: Hepatic safety monitoring, evaluation, and criteria assessment for study drug interruption or discontinuation.

data.name: Parathyroid Hormone Testing

code.decode: Parathormone (parathyroid hormone)

data.label: PTH Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for parathyroid hormone (PTH) levels.

data.name: Serum 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D Testing

code.decode: Vitamin D; 25 hydroxy, includes fraction(s), if performed

data.label: Serum 25-OH Vitamin D
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D levels.

data.name: P1NP Testing

code.decode: Unlisted immunology procedure

data.label: P1NP (Procollagen Type I N-Propeptide)
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for procollagen type I N-propeptide (P1NP) as a bone formation marker.

data.name: CTX-1 Testing

code.decode: Collagen cross links, any method

data.label: CTX-1 (C-Terminal Telopeptide)
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for C-terminal telopeptide (CTX-1) as a bone resorption marker.

data.name: Bone-Specific Alkaline Phosphatase Testing

code.decode: Immunoassay for analyte other than antibody or infectious agent antigen, quantitative

data.label: Bone-Specific ALP
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for bone-specific alkaline phosphatase as a bone formation marker.

data.name: C-Reactive Protein High Sensitivity Testing

code.decode: C-reactive protein; high sensitivity (hsCRP)

data.label: hsCRP Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP).

data.name: Urinary Albumin/Creatinine Ratio Testing

code.decode: Albumin; urine, microalbumin, quantitative

data.label: UACR Test
data.description: Urine sample collection and testing for urinary albumin/creatinine ratio (UACR).

data.name: Mirikizumab SC Self-Administration Training

code.decode: Educational supplies, e.g., books, tapes, provided by the physician for the patient's education at cost to physician

data.label: Injection Training - Mirikizumab SC
data.description: Training of participant and/or caregiver to administer mirikizumab as SC injection using a prefilled syringe. Provided verbally and in written form at first dispensing visit. Refresher training provided as needed.

data.name: Bowel Preparation

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit

data.label: Bowel Preparation for Endoscopy
data.description: Bowel preparation performed prior to endoscopy procedure.

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: Mirikizumab SC Prefilled Syringe
data.description: Prefilled syringe used for subcutaneous self-administration of mirikizumab by participant or caregiver. Initial administration on-site under supervision; subsequent doses can be administered at home.

data.name: Electronic Diary (eDiary)
data.label: eDiary
data.description: Electronic diary used by participants to record daily patient-reported outcomes including CDAI stool frequency, CDAI abdominal pain, CDAI general well-being, and bowel movement count. Applicable to Study Period 1.

data.name: Interactive Web-Response System
data.label: IWRS
data.description: Interactive web-response system used for visit registration, randomization or assignment to ISA, and randomization to study intervention.

data.name: Stool Collection Kit
data.label: Stool Collection Kit
data.description: Kit dispensed to participants for collection of stool samples for fecal calprotectin testing and exploratory biomarker stool supernatant collection.
